description: prices.csv is flagged adjusted=true but is the AS-TRADED series: each 3% quarterly dividend shows as a 3% drop on the ex-date. unadjusted_prices.csv is not delivered, so the ratio test cannot run. The check cannot verify that dividends are applied and must not report the series as consistent.
reviewer_note: Firm on 'not PASS'. A strong tool could even detect the ex-date drops (price falls by ~the dividend on every ex-date) and raise NEEDS_REVIEW.
